scope: General HL7 v2 segment purposes; no version-specific differences are asserted.

provenance.standard: HL7 Version 2 messaging standard segment definitions
provenance.derivation: Concise original paraphrases derived from the standard segment roles and names. These are troubleshooting aids, not reproduced normative text or conformance rules.
provenance.approval: Approved for Kairo segment-purpose help on 2026-09-10.
provenance.licenseNote: No long standards passages are reproduced. Existing field/component definitions retain their separate provenance.

segments.name: Message Header
segments.purpose: Identifies how an HL7 message is encoded, routed, processed, and interpreted, including the sending and receiving systems, message type, control identifier, and declared HL7 version.

segments.name: Message Acknowledgment
segments.purpose: Reports acknowledgment of a received message and correlates the response to the original message control identifier.

segments.name: Error
segments.purpose: Describes message-processing errors or warnings, including where a problem occurred, its coded identity, severity, and supporting diagnostic information.

segments.name: Patient Identification
segments.purpose: Carries patient identity and demographic information used to identify the subject of the message.

segments.name: Additional Demographics
segments.purpose: Carries additional patient demographic and administrative information that supplements PID.

segments.name: Patient Visit
segments.purpose: Carries information about a patient encounter or visit, including patient class, assigned location, responsible providers, and visit identifiers.

segments.name: Patient Visit — Additional Information
segments.purpose: Carries additional encounter information that supplements the patient visit details in PV1.

segments.name: Common Order
segments.purpose: Carries common order-control information shared across order-related messages, including order control, placer and filler identifiers, order status, timing, and ordering context.

segments.name: Observation Request
segments.purpose: Describes a requested observation, diagnostic service, or study and carries the identifiers, service details, timing, specimen context, and ordering information associated with that request.

segments.name: Observation/Result
segments.purpose: Carries one observation or result value together with its identifier, datatype, units, reference information, interpretation, and result status.

segments.name: Notes and Comments
segments.purpose: Carries free-text notes or comments associated with the message or a nearby segment according to the message structure.

segments.name: Diagnosis
segments.purpose: Carries diagnosis information relevant to the patient, encounter, account, or clinical event represented by the message.

segments.name: Patient Allergy Information
segments.purpose: Carries recorded allergy or adverse-reaction information, including the substance, reaction, severity, and identification details when available.

segments.name: Insurance
segments.purpose: Carries primary insurance-plan, coverage, insured-party, authorization, and policy information.

segments.name: Insurance — Additional Information
segments.purpose: Carries additional insured-party and insurance information that supplements IN1.

segments.name: Insurance — Additional Information, Certification
segments.purpose: Carries additional insurance certification, authorization, and benefits information associated with an insurance occurrence.

segments.name: Guarantor
segments.purpose: Carries information about the person or organization financially responsible for the patient account.

segments.name: Next of Kin / Associated Parties
segments.purpose: Carries information about a patient's next of kin or another associated person or organization and their relationship to the patient.

segments.name: Scheduling Activity Information
segments.purpose: Carries the identifiers, timing, duration, status, reason, and administrative context for a scheduled activity or appointment.

segments.name: Resource Group
segments.purpose: Groups related scheduling resources so personnel, locations, services, and other resources can be associated with the same scheduled activity.

segments.name: Appointment Information — General Resource
segments.purpose: Identifies a general resource assigned or requested for a scheduled appointment and its timing or allocation details.

segments.name: Appointment Information — Location Resource
segments.purpose: Identifies a location resource assigned or requested for a scheduled appointment and its timing or status details.

segments.name: Appointment Information — Personnel Resource
segments.purpose: Identifies a personnel resource assigned or requested for a scheduled appointment and its role, timing, or status details.

segments.name: Financial Transaction
segments.purpose: Carries a financial transaction associated with patient care, such as a charge, credit, adjustment, or payment-related entry.

segments.name: Procedures
segments.purpose: Carries information about a procedure performed or recorded for a patient, including its code, date or time, providers, and related clinical context.

segments.name: Event Type
segments.purpose: Carries administrative event information associated with a trigger event, including recorded timing and responsible personnel when present.

segments.name: Merge Patient Information
segments.purpose: Carries prior patient identifiers and account or visit identifiers used when patient records are merged or otherwise linked by an administrative event.

segments.name: Appointment Information — Service
segments.purpose: Identifies a service associated with a scheduled appointment and carries its timing, duration, status, and related scheduling details.
